role: Five XCTest suites for WorkoutLiveTrends.swift: live sample metrics (reverse split, HR drift, aerobic decoupling, recent HR slope, cadence drift), grade-adjusted pace/splits/fade projection, WorkoutZoneBreakdown, TrainingPaceZones/TrainingLoadProjection/RecoveryTimeEstimate, and RaceTimePrediction/WorkoutHistoryBaselines.
types: WorkoutFixture: enum (private, file scope) — shared sample/distance/session fixtures
WorkoutGradeAdjustedPaceTests: class — GAP, per-split GAP, fade projection
TrainingLoadProjectionTests: class — pace zones, ATL/CTL projection, recovery hours
RaceAndHistoryBaselineTests: class — Riegel prediction and history baselines
toplevel: File-scope private enum WorkoutFixture holds static fixture builders; no stored state.

flags.text: Two zone models disagree below 50% of max HR and the tests pin both: WorkoutGeometry.hrMaxZone returns zone 1 for any HR under 60% (HR 40/190 → zone 1) and its comment says threshold zone and displayed zone 'always agree', while WorkoutZoneBreakdown drops time under 50% (dominantZone nil). A zone-1 threshold fires on HR the live breakdown does not count as zone 1.

flags.text: The only assertion is the 5K prediction, but for the 5K target the 10 km effort is outside the +/-20% comparable band, so the comparable filter alone selects the 5K basis. A predictor that picked the longest (or any) basis from the pool would still pass; the fastest-basis rule (min by totalSec) is not exercised.
